name: sneak attack
desc:
Once per turn.
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals an extra 13 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that isn't incapacitated and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
